about: Limits and patterns for discovery-rule-cleanup. scripts/cleanup_plan.py reads this file; change a limit here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.max_changes_per_batch: At most this many disable, date or scope changes go in one batch, with one 'yes'. The rest are listed as the next batch.
notes.max_deletes_per_batch: At most this many deletes go in one batch. Deletes always need their own 'yes' naming each rule, after the other changes.
notes.delete_min_disabled_days: A disabled rule that hasn't expired can only be deleted when it was last changed at least this many days ago, so a recent disable can still be undone. Expired disabled rules can be deleted straight away.
notes.protected_name_pattern: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for rule names that say not to touch them. Such rules are refused unless the change request says the owner agreed (owner_confirmed: true).
notes.running_experiment_statuses: Experiment statuses that block a change: a rule in a bucket of an experiment with one of these statuses is refused.
